An exceptional career opportunity has arisen for a Vocationally Registered General Practitioner holding Specialist Registration to join a well-established and high-demand medical practice in Tahmoor, New South Wales. This position offers a highly lucrative financial package of up to 75% of billings, complemented by a minimum hourly guarantee to ensure a smooth transition. Operating under a busy bulk-billing model, the incoming physician will inherit an immediate, established patient base of 30 to 35 patients per day, ensuring rapid clinical engagement without the constraints of lock-in contracts. The GP-owned and operated practice environment prioritizes complete clinical autonomy, fostering a highly professional and collaborative team culture where medical practitioners can take control of their practice, earnings, and career progression. 

 The facility is highly modern and well-appointed, featuring seven contemporary consulting rooms and a dedicated, fully equipped treatment room designed to handle a broad range of clinical presentations. Utilizing Best Practice software and HotDoc for efficient online bookings, the clinic is optimized for seamless patient care. Doctors are backed by a robust and experienced support network, including full-time administrative staff and a skilled nursing team that assists comprehensively with routine triaging, clinical procedures, and chronic disease management (CDM). With onsite pathology and integrated allied health services, the practice provides a comprehensive care model that naturally accommodates a wide variety of special interest opportunities. Furthermore, the clinic is deeply invested in professional advancement, offering robust CPD training support and rewarding pathways for those interested in pursuing mentor and supervisor opportunities. 

 Recognizing the necessity of a sustainable work-life balance, the practice offers highly flexible working arrangements alongside remote software access, allowing physicians to truly work their way. Situated in a sought-after DPA/MM5 eligible location, this position is ideal for 19AB restricted GPs looking for a high-opportunity site to satisfy their moratorium requirements. Located in the scenic Wollondilly Shire, the rapidly growing township of Tahmoor offers fantastic lifestyle benefits. Residents can enjoy beautiful natural surroundings, great local schools, and comprehensive local amenities, all while remaining highly connected to major urban hubs—situated just 35 minutes from Campbelltown and a convenient 90-minute drive from the Sydney CBD.

Level 2 IT Administrator | Permanent Position | FIFO Option    Your new company     
 Join a large-scale, high-profile infrastructure project based in Cooma, supporting critical operations within a complex and dynamic IT environment. 
   
 This organisation brings together enterprise platforms, site-based infrastructure, and global support teams, offering a unique opportunity to work across a broad technology stack. 
   
 For candidates based outside the region, FIFO arrangements and accommodation support can be considered. 
   Your new role     
 As a Level 2 IT Administrator, you will act as a hybrid on-site IT generalist, primarily based in Cooma, with travel required every alternate week. You will deliver a mix of end-user support, infrastructure support, and application administration. 
   
  Key responsibilities include:  
 
 Deliver Level 2 end-user and service desk support across hardware, software, and systems 
 Provide Level 1 support for key business applications such as Aconex, Primavera P6, Revit, Revizto, and SAP ECTR 
 Support infrastructure including networks, endpoints, and site connectivity (Level 2) 
 Troubleshoot and resolve issues across Microsoft 365, Windows, Azure, Citrix, and SAP environments 
 Coordinate with internal IT, DSI support teams, and third-party vendors to resolve incidents 
 Maintain documentation for systems, configurations, and support activities 
 Ensure IT systems meet security and compliance standards 
 Manage IT assets including hardware/software inventory and lifecycle 
 Support application administration including user access, configuration, and maintenance 
 
   
  Workload split:  
 
 End-user support: 50% 
 Infrastructure support: 30% 
 Application support: 10% 
 Asset management and administration: 10% 
 
  What you'll need to succeed     
 
 Proven experience in a Level 2 IT support or systems administration role 
 Strong troubleshooting skills across hardware, software, networking, and systems 
 Experience with Microsoft 365, Windows, Azure, Citrix, and general infrastructure 
 Ability to manage competing priorities in a hands-on, site-based environment 
 Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with multiple support teams 
 
   
  Desirable experience:  
 
 SharePoint 
 Primavera P6 Professional 
 Aconex 
 Autodesk Revit / Revizto 
 SAP ECTR 
 LMS or specialist project management tools 
 
 
 Experience in construction, engineering, or project-based environments will be highly regarded. 
 
  What you'll get in return     
 
 Salary package of $160,000 - $180,000 + super 
 Accommodation support where required 
 FIFO options available for non-local candidates 
 Opportunity to work on a major infrastructure project 
 Exposure to a broad and technically diverse environment 
 A hands-on role with strong ownership and autonomy 
 
  What you need to do now         If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV to  charlie.pym@hays.com.au .    If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.    Please  click here  to apply.
